_comment: Every interactive element the wiki may embed. Authors write `<!-- sggs:<name> attr="value" -->` in plain Markdown (invisible on GitHub); remark-widgets turns it into `<sggs-<name>>` on the site and refuses unknown names or attributes. Each widget must be followed by a static fallback (tools/docs_check.py).

status.purpose: Live production version, commit, build date and health checks from /api/health.

walkthrough.purpose: Inserted by remark-posters around an inlined poster; not written by authors (use ![alt](../diagrams/posters/NN-slug.svg)).

ang-explorer.purpose: Live Ang explorer: every line record of an Ang from /api/ang/{n}, verbatim, with the columns annotated; quick picks and header/rahao filters.

ang.description: The Ang to open first (1–1430); default 1.

code.purpose: A code excerpt read from the real source at build time (this repository at the documented commit, or a pinned sibling from sources.lock.json) — never a pasted copy. Resolved by plugins/remark-code-excerpt.mjs; no JavaScript.

repo.description: A source name from docs-site/sources.lock.json (e.g. sggs-data); omitted = this repository.

symbol.description: A function/class/const name to excerpt (language-aware); the excerpt runs to the end of its block.

lines.description: An explicit range, e.g. 23-60, instead of a symbol.

waterfall.purpose: Search simulator: runs /api/search and lights the tier that answered on poster 05; results verbatim with their Ang.

limit.description: How many results to show (1–20); default 8. The home page shows 3.

verify.purpose: Verification playground: runs /api/verify and lights the verdict rung on poster 07; the matched line verbatim with its Ang and the scoring details.

api-try.purpose: Try-it console for any route: a parameter form from contract/openapi.json (embedded at build by remark-api-try), the live response, headers, and copy-as-curl.

route.description: The route to open first, e.g. /api/ang/{n}.

quiz.purpose: Self-check questions: `<!-- sggs:quiz -->` followed by a ```quiz fence (Q: lines and answers, the right one marked ✓ — why). No backend; the fence reads as text on GitHub.

term.purpose: Inserted by remark-terms for [[Term]]; not written by authors as a comment. Hover-card with the glossary definition.

progress.purpose: Learning-path checklist: enhances the list that follows with checkboxes remembered in this browser only (localStorage, per path).

path.description: A short key for the path, e.g. platform-engineer.

repo-map.purpose: An expandable map of the three repositories with a one-line purpose per path, rendered at build from docs/reference/repo-map.json (remark-repo-map); no JavaScript.

adr-timeline.purpose: The ADRs on a timeline, rendered at build from docs/adr/*.md (remark-adr-timeline); no JavaScript.

releases.purpose: CHANGELOG.md as a release timeline, rendered at build (remark-releases), with a filter box on the site; `limit` keeps the newest N.

limit.description: Show only the newest N releases (no filter box), e.g. on the home page.

cards.purpose: Turns the Markdown list that follows into a grid of cards at build (remark-cards): each item is `[Title](link) — one sentence`. No JavaScript; on GitHub the list itself is the fallback.

swatches.purpose: The brand palette from docs/brand/tokens.json, rendered at build (remark-swatches): every role, light and dark, with a swatch and its contrast ratio. No JavaScript.
